item.title: Australia: National AI Plan to Drive Innovation, Transformation
item.description: Australia’s National AI Plan outlines a comprehensive strategic framework to integrate AI across industries, public services, and infrastructure, driving innovation, economic growth and workforce development.

item.title: Vietnam Strengthens Ethical and Human-Centred AI Development
item.description: Vietnam is advancing responsible, people-centred AI through ethical frameworks, transparency, human oversight and global collaboration to ensure safe, inclusive and innovative technology development.

item.title: Singapore: IMDA Talent Accelerator to Boost Media Industry
item.description: IMDA has launched the S$200 million Talent Accelerator Programme to develop Singapore’s media talent, grow original IPs and expand international global partnerships rapidly, fostering innovation and creative excellence.

item.title: Malaysia: Digital Integration Advances Public Housing Finance
item.description: Malaysia has integrated its Loan Management System with the Housing Integrated Management System to streamline public sector housing finance, enhance data accuracy, reduce fraud and improve operational efficiency.

item.title: India: DigiLocker Integration Simplifies Passport Verification
item.description: India has made Passport Verification Records easily accessible on DigiLocker, enabling secure, fully paperless and convenient digital access, storage, sharing and instant online verification for citizens nationwide.

item.title: Australia: Advanced Biomanufacturing Hub Launches in Victoria
item.description: Australia’s new cell-based vaccine facility in Victoria significantly enhances domestic production, strengthens pandemic preparedness, and positions the country as a leader in advanced, flexible biomanufacturing.

item.title: The Philippines: Strengthening Online Safety for Women and Children
item.description: The Philippines is strengthening digital literacy and safety programs through police-led initiatives and ChildFund projects to protect women and children from cybercrime and online exploitation.

item.title: Hong Kong: Smart Climate Resilience Laboratory for Coastal Cities
item.description: New state laboratory focuses on advanced climate modelling, resilient infrastructure technologies and improved early-warning systems to strengthen coastal cities against extreme weather impacts.

item.title: Vietnam: Greener, Smarter, Inclusive E-commerce Evolution
item.description: Vietnam’s e-commerce sector is growing sustainably, driven by digital innovation, greener logistics, regulatory oversight and support for SMEs to ensure inclusive and efficient market development.

item.title: Singapore–EU Digital Partnership Enters a New Phase
item.description: Singapore and the European Union have refreshed their Digital Partnership with cooperation across AI, cybersecurity, data flows and emerging technologies to strengthen innovation and digital resilience.
